# Lab 6.10: Query Performance Insights

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a skewed query, then use the console's performance insights and the JOBS view to find slot contention and data skew.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Run a skewed join.** Most rows share one key, so one worker does most of the work.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">WITH skewed AS (
  SELECT IF(RAND() &lt; 0.9, 'hot', CAST(taxi_id AS STRING)) AS k, fare FROM lab06.trips_flat
)
SELECT a.k, COUNT(*) AS c
FROM skewed a JOIN skewed b USING (k)
WHERE a.k != 'hot' OR RAND() &lt; 0.0001
GROUP BY a.k ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Open Performance insights.** In **Execution graph**, stages with problems show a warning icon. Click it to read insights such as **data skew** or **slot contention**, with a compared earlier run.

3. **[CLI] Read insights from JOBS.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT job_id, query_info.performance_insights
 FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
 WHERE query_info.performance_insights IS NOT NULL
   AND creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
 ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 5'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Fix the skew.** Filter or pre-aggregate the hot key before the join, then compare slot time.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Skew | One key dominates a stage |
| Insights | Shown in the execution graph |
| JOBS view | `performance_insights` field |
| Fix | Handle hot keys before joining |
